subject: Upcoming Team Building Event
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce our upcoming team building event scheduled for next Friday at the city park. This event will be a great opportunity for everyone to bond and have some fun outside of the office. Please mark your calendars and get ready for a day filled with team activities, games, and a delicious barbecue lunch. More details regarding the schedule and logistics will be shared soon. We look forward to seeing everyone there! Best regards, [Your Name]
